reason: Lemma read in Zhou Sec. 4.2.1 pp. 18-20 and Rocha-Caridi Sec. 7 pp. 345-348. Proof strategy: downward induction on the weight order; N in O has weights in a finite union of cones lambda_i - Q^+ (prop-equivalent-support-description-of-category-o), so the induction terminates; writing a class in N/n^-N as sum c_i phi(v_i) with weight-vector generators forces wt phi(v_i) = mu for nonzero coefficients, and the remainder lies in n^-N = sum_alpha f_alpha N_{mu+alpha}, to which the induction hypothesis applies. Exactness of the induction uses thm-pbw-model-of-a-verma-module for freeness of M(psi) over U(n^-). All deps examined and published.
